a part card states its function
a part card lists its interfaces (free parts, and a one-part dossier, excepted)
a part card, or another card or the section it is in, records a decision
a card lists only interfaces whose `between` names the part or its section
an interface between two parts is listed on both parts' cards
the two sections that declare an interface agree on its datum (§5.4)
the two declarations of an interface agree on its other fields
a card's fastener runs `via` an interface between this part and `to`
a gates.intended_overlaps or ignore_pairs entry names parts, part instances or fasteners the build registered
a card checked by gate:wall (an error) or made by an additive process (a warning) declares material.wall_mm
a decided decision has a `why` and at least one alternative
every alternative says why it was rejected
every requirement is referenced by a section
every requirement has a check (its own, or one on a card of its sections)
a waived requirement says why in `rationale`
a requirement's status is computed; only `waived` belongs in YAML
a section names the requirements it serves
a section has part cards
a card claims reviewed/signed_off only with a current reviewer record
a card's YAML status is not above the computed one
a reviewer record is valid (cadagent.dossier.review.validate_record: its fields, each answer with evidence, a sign-off consistent with its findings and answers)
a reviewer record names a section of the dossier
a review is by an actor who neither built nor wrote any part of the section, and not `unknown` (gates: require_separate_reviewer)
a current review of a section whose parts were built by a known actor (else nobody can be shown to be someone else, and it does not count)

a current review judges every decision and traces every requirement of its section, and answers exactly the questions of the packet on disk (else it does not count; cadagent.dossier.review.check_record)
the latest review still matches the geometry (else its sign-off is void)
a section with an open decision is not signed off
the build's geometry record exists, so cards can be joined to shapes
the geometry record is readable JSON
a gate verdict is readable JSON
a gate verdict was computed from the current geometry record (its inputs match)
